points: Your site shows 528 reviews, yet only 2 of 30 ads carry any review count. A first time buyer needs that proof before clicking. Put 528 reviews on the creative and open two new ads with a review quote.
Your site offers 29% off Hair Color Cream, yet only 2 of 20 ads mention percent off. A first time buyer has no reason to act today. Put the 29% saving in the first line of each new ad.

Your 20 written ads open with 16 different stories, and the top one opens only 3. Each opening starts from zero, so no story builds the repeat views that stick. Pick the two strongest and build the next batch from them.
27 of your 30 ads have run 60 days or more, so you have proven winners. Get Your Glow On has run longest, so it is the safest base. Make three variations with fresh openings for new buyers.

ads_1: Glow Line and Hair Color Cream creative, one proven story, reviews in line one
